All prices are stated in euro (€) including 19% VAT, Registration and Road Tax.
Prices and equipment subject to change without notice.
Unicars Ltd will not be liable for any damage or loss arising from any errors or omissions in the information contained
in this pricelist or arising from the use of the information contained herein.

*The maximum electric power output was determined in accordance with UN-GTR.21 and is available for a maximum of 30
seconds.
The power available in the individual driving situation depends on variable factors such as the outside temperature,
temperature conditions, state of charge, conditioning state or physical ageing of the high-voltage battery. Availability of
maximum power output requires in particular a high-voltage battery temperature between 23 °C and 50 °C and a battery
charge state of > 55% for the 59kWh battery and > 85% for the 77kWh battery. This pricelist was issued in October 2025.
